source: VCP production Agent Settings Electron Surface

findings.impact: The production evidence gate detects an authored display:flex rule for the Harness model trigger. The trigger currently depends on owner-bound inline !important styles, so legacy presentation remains active and can regress after dispose or stylesheet order changes.

evidence.result: FAIL: Agent action openModelSelectBtn has a conflicting authored display:flex rule

findings.smallestCorrection: Retire every Agent-specific legacy selector that matches .vcp-harness-agent-model-picker-trigger (including the checked-in settings-model-select.css source), then add a negative selector gate. Do not broaden the change to group/global model controls until they have their own consumer contract.

findings.impact: After selecting a model, reopening the picker leaves its internal pane at model. Escape then only returns to the root pane and does not dismiss or restore trigger focus.
reproSequence: Dispatch Escape on the picker card
findings.rootCause: The trigger click handler opens popup directly without resetting pane='root'. The public open() helper resets the pane, but production uses the trigger listener path.
findings.minimalCorrection: Reset pane='root' before popup.open() in the trigger click handler, or route the trigger handler through the same open() transaction; add a reopen-after-selection regression sequence.

evidenceGaps: The default npm Agent Settings command does not enable VCPCHAT_STRESS_AGENT_MODEL_PICKER_INTERACTION=1.
No same-engine 1280x800 or 1680x1000 production capture is currently recorded for this control.
The checked-in production screenshot is collapsed at 800x600, so trigger geometry is not visually inspectable without opening the identity/model sections.
